name: NGine\Image\ImageResize
short_desc: PHP class to resize and scale images

addFilter.name: addFilter
addFilter.short_desc: Add filter function for use right before save image to file.

filterType.name: filterType
filterType.short_desc: int type and default value is IMG_FILTER_NEGATE

__construct.name: __construct
__construct.short_desc: Loads image source and its properties to the instanciated object

__toString.name: __toString
__toString.short_desc: Convert the image to string with the current settings

resizeToShortSide.name: resizeToShortSide
resizeToShortSide.short_desc: Resizes image according to the given short side (short side proportional)

resizeToLongSide.name: resizeToLongSide
resizeToLongSide.short_desc: Resizes image according to the given long side (short side proportional)

resizeToHeight.name: resizeToHeight
resizeToHeight.short_desc: Resizes image according to the given height (width proportional)

resizeToWidth.name: resizeToWidth
resizeToWidth.short_desc: Resizes image according to the given width (height proportional)

resizeToBestFit.name: resizeToBestFit
resizeToBestFit.short_desc: Resizes image to best fit inside the given dimensions

scale.name: scale
scale.short_desc: Resizes image according to given scale (proportionally)

resize.name: resize
resize.short_desc: Resizes image according to the given width and height

crop.name: crop
crop.short_desc: Crops image according to the given width, height and crop position

freecrop.name: freecrop
freecrop.short_desc: Crops image according to the given width, height, x and y

getDestWidth.name: getDestWidth
getDestWidth.short_desc: Gets width of the destination image

getDestHeight.name: getDestHeight
getDestHeight.short_desc: Gets height of the destination image

getCropPosition.name: getCropPosition
getCropPosition.short_desc: Gets crop position (X or Y) according to the given position

gamma.name: gamma
gamma.short_desc: Enable or not the gamma color correction on the image, enabled by default
